an5.37:1.1: “Bhikkhus, a donor who gives food gives the recipients five things.
an5.37:1.3: One gives life, beauty, happiness, strength, and discernment.
an5.37:1.4: (1) Having given life, one partakes of life, whether celestial or human.
an5.37:1.5: (2) Having given beauty, one partakes of beauty, whether celestial or human.
an5.37:1.6: (3) Having given happiness, one partakes of happiness, whether celestial or human.
an5.37:1.7: (4) Having given strength, one partakes of strength, whether celestial or human.
an5.37:1.8: (5) Having given discernment, one partakes of discernment, whether celestial or human.
an5.37:1.9: A donor who gives food gives the recipients these five things.”
an5.37:2.1: The wise one is a giver of life,
an5.37:2.3: The intelligent one is a donor of happiness
